title: Finger Lakes
html:
Finger Lakes is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by crunchybbb — Six skinny lakes connecting to a river; located in upstate New York.

Nations

The map features 10 named nations, including Ithaca, Penn Yan, Watkins Glen, Geneva, Seneca Falls and Lyons.
